parameters.name: BatchId
parameters.description: The ID of the release batch.

sub_parameters.name: GroupId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the server group.
> Call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~DescribeAllGroups~~) operation to query the server group ID.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description:
The operation type. Valid values:

- **add**: increase.
- **del**: delete.

sub_parameters.name: Uuid
sub_parameters.description:
The UUID of the server.
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

sub_parameters.name: VpcInstanceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the VPC-connected instance.
